build_notes: Proof-of-concept for V2 schema. 35 entries spanning 9 categories. Sources biased toward public domain (Bible KJV, Shakespeare, Thoreau, Muir, Lincoln, Jefferson, Buddha) + folk proverbs + idioms. Short attributed fragments only from modern figures. One compound-override entry (sidewalk) included to exercise the override path. pun_version is the deterministic output of walkenify(original_quote).
